description: End-to-end tool execution proof: two real bash tool calls, then a final answer. The first runs a read-only command and prints a sentinel, the second writes a file into the session workspace so the result can be read back off-device with `run-as`. Start the mock with this script and send one message; a single run consumes all three steps.

steps.reasoning: Prove the dispatcher reaches a real shell: print the working directory, list it, and emit a sentinel.
Prove the command's side effects land on the real filesystem: create a file and read it straight back.

arguments.command: mkdir -p proof && echo made > proof/marker.txt && cat proof/marker.txt

steps.text: Both commands ran; the marker file was written and read back.
